_about: Input contract for n8n/client-report-generator. Mirrors the fixtures embedded in its 'Demo config (fixture)' and 'Demo * fetch' code nodes. The one-click demo lane replays demo_config_rows exactly — nothing here needs to be repointed at a trigger.

config_row_shape._comment: One row per client in the 'config' Google Sheet tab. Every src_*/sink_* flag, plus delivery_mode / brand_* / alert_threshold_pct, is a cell the owner edits — the workflow is never touched.
config_row_shape.delivery_mode: send | draft  (optional — defaults to send; draft files a Gmail draft for review instead of sending)
config_row_shape.brand_name: optional — report header brand; defaults to client_name
config_row_shape.brand_color: optional — e.g. #33475b; an invalid value falls back to a neutral default
config_row_shape.brand_logo_url: optional — empty renders no ; the layout never depends on it
config_row_shape.alert_threshold_pct: optional — e.g. 15; any metric whose |WoW delta| reaches this is FLAGGED in the report and counted in the digest
config_row_shape._fixture_only_fields: sim_error_source and already_sent exist only in demo_config_rows — they fake a source outage and pre-seed the dedupe check. Real config rows never carry them.

edge_cases._comment: Which edge case each demo row exercises, and the verdict the engine produces. The demo code adds live:false to every row.
edge_cases.acme: all three sources + both sinks; sim_error_source:meta_ads fakes a Meta outage → one 'failure' alert via Compose source alert; google_ads + ga4 still report; delivered via Gmail + Slack
edge_cases.boutique: already_sent:yes pre-seeds the dedupe key → Dedupe check flags is_duplicate → Already sent? → Compose duplicate alert; nothing is re-sent
edge_cases.coachlee: sink_gmail:yes but recipients_email empty → no usable sink → Validate clients emits a 'missing-data' alert; the row never reaches the engine
edge_cases.pausedco: enabled:no → Validate clients marks it 'skipped'; one skipped line in the run digest

source_adapter_payloads._contract: Every adapter — live or demo, existing or docked at 'Extension dock' — emits contract rows {kind:'metric', client_id, client_name, source, report_date, metric, value, prev_value, sinks, recipients_email, slack_channel, live, delivery_mode, brand_name, brand_color, brand_logo_url, alert_threshold_pct}. 'Compute WoW deltas' adds delta_pct deterministically; the AI only ever sees the finished table. The raw fetch-response shapes below are what each 'Normalize *' node consumes; numbers match the committed acme demo fixture so the same deltas reproduce.

meta_ads.normalize_note: 'Normalize Meta Ads' treats data[last] as this week and data[last-1] as previous week, then emits one contract row per metric in [spend, impressions, clicks].

google_ads.normalize_note: 'Normalize Google Ads' groups searchStream results by segments.week (latest = this week, previous = last), converts cost_micros to dollars, and emits one contract row per metric in [spend, clicks, conversions]. The committed acme fixture exercises spend + conversions; the clicks row below shows the remaining shape.

ga4.normalize_note: 'Normalize GA4' sums metricValues by dimension: date_range_0 = this week, date_range_1 = previous; index 0 = sessions, index 1 = conversions.
